lines.speaker: Uncle Sirisena
lines.text: Good, good! That is what I told everyone. Share it everywhere. People need to know.
You forwarded it. 847 people just became 848 potential sources. Somewhere in Alupotha, someone is now planning to rush to the Grama Sevaka Office on Friday.
The registration deadline is actually Week 4. The message was false. The town does not know that yet.
